```{r}
#install.packages("baseballr")

library(baseballr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#install.packages("remotes")

library(remotes)
install_github("BillPetti/baseballr")
```

```{r}
playerid_lookup(last_name = "Judge",
                first_name = "Aaron")
```

```{r}
start_date <- "2023-03-01"
end_date <- "2023-10-01"  # Adjust if playoffs needed


judge_id <- playerid_lookup("Judge", "Aaron")$mlbam_id


judge_pitches <- statcast_search(
  start_date = start_date,
  end_date = end_date,
  player_type = "batter",
  playerid = judge_id
)
```
